full_prompt_en: A square, weathered color-film photograph shows a young woman turning toward the camera against a softly blurred, pale blue-green background. Her face fills most of the frame, angled slightly toward the left, while one dark eye looks directly out beneath a loose sweep of brown hair. Along the upper edge, stray strands catch a pale golden glow and break the otherwise dark shape of her hair. The left side of the background is washed with cool light, with only indistinct vertical forms visible; the right edge falls into a deep olive-black shadow. Her nose and cheek form the sharpest contours in the picture. Warm peach and muted rose color gathers across the cheek and around her slightly parted lips, while cooler greenish shade softens the side of her face nearer the background. At the lower edge, a dark garment and a pale, softly textured collar curve around her neck, partly disappearing into shadow. The framing crops her head close at the top and her shoulders at the bottom, giving the moment the immediacy of an unposed still. Light enters from the upper left, tracing loose hair and the bridge of her nose before fading gently over her jaw and clothing. Fine grain, faint scratches, softened focus, and uneven color make the image feel like an aged photographic print rather than a polished studio portrait. The overall composition balances a luminous cool margin with a warm face and large dark areas, creating an intimate, fleeting mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形、带岁月痕迹的彩色胶片照片呈现一名转头望向镜头的年轻女子，背景是柔焦的浅蓝绿色。她的脸占据画面大部，略朝左侧转动，一只深色眼睛从松散垂落的棕发下直视画外。上缘处，零散发丝接住浅金色微光，打破头发原本连成一片的深色形状。背景左侧被冷光洗亮，只能看见模糊的竖向形体；右边缘沉入深橄榄黑色阴影。鼻梁和脸颊形成照片里最清楚的轮廓。暖桃色与低调玫瑰色聚在脸颊和微张的嘴唇周围，靠近背景的一侧脸部则被偏绿的冷影柔化。下缘处，深色衣服和一圈浅色、柔软且有纹理的衣领围住颈部，又部分消失在阴影里。头顶和肩膀都被画幅贴近裁切，使这一刻带有未经摆拍的即时感。光从左上方进入，描亮散发与鼻梁，再沿下颌和衣物轻柔衰减。细颗粒、浅划痕、略软的焦点和不均匀的色彩，让画面更像一张老旧相纸，而非光洁的影棚肖像。整体构图用明亮的冷色边缘平衡暖色面庞和大片暗部，形成亲密而稍纵即逝的气氛。
style_prompt_en: A weathered color-film photographic treatment combines soft focus, visible fine grain, faint surface scuffs, and uneven dye-like color. Warm amber, peach, and muted rose pool inside broad olive-brown shadows, while cool cyan-green light opens small areas of breathing room. Highlights bloom gently into neighboring tones instead of ending at hard edges; only a few focal contours remain comparatively crisp. Shallow depth compresses the space, and a close crop lets luminous passages meet deep darkness without a clean separation. Directional light catches the highest edges and falls away gradually, with slight haze and color shifts giving the tonal transitions a tactile, aged-print quality. The composition feels intimate and transient through its asymmetrical balance of warm concentration, cool diffusion, and generous shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 这种带岁月痕迹的彩色胶片摄影效果结合柔焦、可见细颗粒、浅表擦痕与不均匀的染料般色彩。暖琥珀、桃色和低调玫瑰色聚在宽阔的橄榄棕色阴影中，冷青绿色光线则打开少量透气区域。高光轻柔漫溢到邻近色调，而不是停在坚硬边缘；只有少数焦点轮廓相对清晰。浅景深压缩空间，贴近的裁切让明亮色域与深暗部相接，却没有整齐的分界。定向光抓住最高的边缘后逐渐衰减，薄雾感和轻微色偏使明暗过渡呈现可触摸的旧相纸质地。构图借暖色聚焦、冷色弥散与宽裕阴影的不对称平衡，形成亲密而短暂的感觉。
theme_en: A softly focused young woman turning toward the camera in a weathered color-film close-up
theme_zh: 褪色彩色胶片特写中，一名年轻女子转头望向镜头
name: Stefanie Schneider
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
